steps: Rinse the quinoa in a sieve until the water runs clear, then rinse the rice.
Cut the boneless chicken into very small pieces and chop the carrot small.
Heat the ghee in a pressure cooker on medium, add the cumin, let it crackle, then stir in the chopped garlic for a few seconds.
Add the chicken, turmeric and about 200 ml water a child, and boil with the lid off for 5 minutes.
Stir in the quinoa, rice and carrot.
Close the lid, cook on medium for 3 to 4 whistles and let the pressure drop on its own.
Shred any bigger chicken pieces with a fork and mash lightly so it stays soft and moist.
Cool until just warm before serving.
note: No salt or stock cube; the chicken boils in the pot and flavours the grains. Rinsing the quinoa takes away its bitter coating.
